metadata.description: Personal marketplace for forge-sdlc. Add this repository, then install forge-sdlc at project scope in a host.

plugins.name: forge-sdlc
plugins.description: The AI-native SDLC loop as a team of agents over Matt Pocock's skills, with the run pane (/forge-pane, a figures band above the prompt with the H handoff button, the /forge help panel, per-role routing and crew names from docs/agents/forge.md) and the workbench mod: /focus-pane, /boards, a needs-you band above the prompt, /diff-pane, /side-chat, /morning, /crew. Depends on mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official.
